exercise.name: Single-Arm Cable Reverse Fly
library_steps: Set a pulley at shoulder height and stand with your side to it.
Hold the handle with your far hand, arm straight across your chest.
Pull your arm back and out to the side, then return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
exercise.one_line_summary: Standing side-on to a shoulder-height pulley, the far hand holds the D-handle; the nearly straight arm moves at shoulder height from across the chest out to the side. Rear delt does the work; the middle trapezius/rhomboids help.

setup.target: Shoulder height, on the other side of the body.
Nearly straight, at shoulder height, neutral grip.

movement.measure: arm angle in the shoulder-height plane, 0 = out to the side, +90 = forward
movement.end: -8 (out to the side, a little back)

muscles.emg: Horizontal abduction at shoulder height gave among the highest posterior deltoid activity (S1).
muscles.role: Pulls the arm back and out; what the exercise is for.

muscles.emg: Horizontal extension gave the highest middle-trapezius EMG of 10 exercises (S2).
muscles.role: Draws the shoulder blade back; library secondary.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Chest rotates open with the arm.
mistakes.why_it_matters: The shoulder, not the trunk, should move.

sources.citation: Reinold MM, Wilk KE, Fleisig GS, et al. 2004. Electromyographic analysis of the rotator cuff and deltoid musculature during common shoulder external rotation exercises. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther 34(7):385-394.
sources.what_it_gave: Prone horizontal abduction (arm moving out and back at shoulder height) gave among the highest posterior deltoid activity of the exercises tested.

sources.citation: Ekstrom RA, Donatelli RA, Soderberg GL. 2003. Surface electromyographic analysis of exercises for the trapezius and serratus anterior muscles. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther 33(5):247-258.
sources.what_it_gave: 10 exercises, 30 subjects: the shrug gave the highest upper-trapezius EMG; shoulder horizontal extension (arm moving back at shoulder height) the highest middle trapezius; the prone overhead raise in a Y the highest lower trapezius.

clip_check.check: Start: arm across the chest at shoulder height
End: arm out to the side
Fist closed on the handle; cable passes in front of the chest, clear of it
Rear delt strongest red, working side only
